description: US NRC operating nuclear power reactor licences: plant/unit name, docket number, operating licence number (e.g. DPR-51, NPF-6), reactor type (PWR/BWR), location and state, owner/operator, NRC region and facility page, joined with the NRC daily power status: latest report date, current power level (% of rated) and the last 7 days. Filter by state, operator, reactor type or name. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

name.description: Optional words of the plant name, e.g. Vogtle

operator.description: Optional words of the owner/operator, e.g. Constellation, Entergy

type.description: Optional reactor type: PWR or BWR

name: gov_nrc_licenses
title: Gov Nrc Licenses
